# `scm4opt.physics`

Physical modules; each has load_*_params and a step function.

Modules: [`scm4opt.physics.atmosphere`](#scm4optphysicsatmosphere), [`scm4opt.physics.chemistry`](#scm4optphysicschemistry), [`scm4opt.physics.doeclim`](#scm4optphysicsdoeclim), [`scm4opt.physics.forcing`](#scm4optphysicsforcing), [`scm4opt.physics.forcing_data`](#scm4optphysicsforcing_data), [`scm4opt.physics.halo_data`](#scm4optphysicshalo_data), [`scm4opt.physics.land`](#scm4optphysicsland), [`scm4opt.physics.ocean_hector`](#scm4optphysicsocean_hector), [`scm4opt.physics.ocean_models`](#scm4optphysicsocean_models), [`scm4opt.physics.ocean_oscar`](#scm4optphysicsocean_oscar)


## `scm4opt.physics.atmosphere`

```text
Atmospheric carbon pool of SCM4OPT (equation scm_ATMOEQ).

Default form of scm_ATMOEQ:

    scm_atmo_pool(t) =E= ( scm_atmo_pool(t-1)
                         + dat_eind(t,"co2")
                         + scm_emeth(t-1)
                         - scm_atmoSeaFlux(t-1)
                         - scm_atmoLndFlux(t-1) )$(not tfirst(t))
                       + (co2_conc_1850 * PPM2GTC)$tfirst(t);

All pools are in GtC and all fluxes in GtC per model time step (the model
runs at 1/6-year steps; the series are used as-is, no rescaling).
Land-use CO2 emissions (dat_elnd) are not added here: they enter through the land
module (deforestation fluxes in lnd_atmoLndFlux, land.py).
```

### class `AtmosphereParams`

Atmosphere parameters.

Fields: `pool_1850`

### class `AtmosphereDrivers`

Inputs of one atmosphere step t (all in GtC per step).

Fields: `eind_co2`, `emeth_prev`, `sea_flux_prev`, `lnd_flux_prev`

### `load_atmosphere_params(cfg=None)`

Atmosphere parameters of a run configuration.

### `atmosphere_step(p, prev, drivers)`

scm_ATMOEQ for step t: the atmospheric carbon pool [GtC].

prev    : scm_atmo_pool(t-1), or None at the first step (-> p.pool_1850)
drivers : AtmosphereDrivers (ignored at the first step)

### `atmo_pool_series(eind_co2, emeth, sea_flux, lnd_flux, co2_conc_1850=284.0, ppm2gtc=2.123)`

scm_ATMOEQ over the whole time axis t = 0 (tfirst = 1850) .. n-1.

Inputs are 1-D arrays of equal length indexed by t. Returns scm_atmo_pool(t).
In the coupled model the ocean/land fluxes depend on the pool itself, so a
full model run has to call atmosphere_step inside the main time loop; this
helper is for the case where the flux series are already known (e.g. from
saved model output).

Constants: `CO2_CONC_1850`, `PPM2GTC`


## `scm4opt.physics.chemistry`

```text
Atmospheric chemistry: CH4, N2O, halogenated gases, ozone and aerosols.

Concentrations are anomalies (D_*) on top of baselines (CH4_0, N2O_0, HALO_0).
CH4, N2O and the 48 halogenated gases are stocks updated by explicit Euler with
the sinks of the previous step; ozone and aerosols are diagnostics.

A step is split in two because the OH and photolysis sinks need temperature at
the SAME step, which DOECLIM only provides after forcing:

  chemistry_step(n)    stocks from n-1 sinks; EESC, O3t, O3s, aerosols (tatm at n-1)
  ... forcing(n) -> DOECLIM(n) -> tatm(n) ...
  chemistry_finish(n)  kOH, hv (tatm at n) -> sinks(n), emeth(n)   [used at n+1]

All chemistry model choices are available: the option tables below are keyed by
the option names and are selected with config.ChemOptions (the chemistry model
options, --..._mdl flags). The default options give the SCM4OPT v4.1 defaults.

--load_conc (prescribed concentrations) is supported through ChemDrivers(prescribed=...).
Not included: the --cali_chem calibration branch.
```

### class `ChemParams`

All chemistry parameters (model names); build with load_chem_params().

Fields: `co2_init`, `ch4_init`, `n2o_init`, `co2_0`, `ch4_0`, `n2o_0`, `d_ch4_1850`, `d_n2o_1850`, `alpha_ch4`, `scale_oh`, `tau_ch4_oh`, `tau_ch4_hv`, `tau_ch4_soil`, `tau_ch4_ocean`, `oh_sink_form`, `chi_oh_tatm`, `chi_oh_qatm`, `chi_oh_o3`, `chi_oh_ch4`, `chi_oh_nox`, `chi_oh_co`, `chi_oh_voc`, `k_tatm`, `k_qatm`, `tatm_0`, `k_svp`, `t_svp`, `o3s_0`, `e_nox_oh`, `e_co_oh`, `e_voc_oh`, `alpha_n2o`, `tau_n2o_hv`, `chi_hv_n2o`, `chi_hv_eesc`, `chi_hv_age`, `gamma_age`, `tau_lag`, `chi_o3t_ch4`, `chi_o3t_co`, `chi_o3t_voc`, `chi_o3t_nox`, `gamma_o3t`, `chi_o3s_eesc`, `gamma_o3s`, `chi_o3s_n2o`, `eesc_x`, `alpha_br`, `d_o3t_1850`, `d_o3s_1850`, `d_so4_1850`, `d_poa_1850`, `d_bc_1850`, `d_no3_1850`, `d_soa_1850`, `alpha_so4`, `alpha_no3`, `alpha_pom`, `scale_pom`, `scale_bc`, `tau_so2`, `tau_dms`, `gamma_so4`, `tau_om_ff`, `tau_om_bb`, `gamma_poa`, `tau_bc_ff`, `tau_bc_bb`, `gamma_bc`, `tau_nox`, `tau_nh3`, `gamma_no3`, `tau_voc`, `tau_bvoc`, `gamma_soa`, `tau_dust`, `gamma_dust`, `tau_salt`, `gamma_salt`, `solub_so4`, `solub_poa`, `solub_bc`, `solub_no3`, `solub_soa`, `solub_dust`, `solub_salt`, `d_ebb_ch4`, `d_ebb_n2o`, `d_ebb_nh3`, `d_e_wet`, `d_ebb_co`, `d_ebb_so2`, `d_ebb_oc`, `d_ebb_bc`, `d_ebb_nox`, `d_ebb_voc`, `alpha_halo`, `tau_halo_oh`, `tau_halo_hv`, `tau_halo_other`, `tau_halo_total`, `halo_0`, `f_fracrel`, `n_cl`, `n_br`, `gwp100`, `eesc_0`, `dt`

## `scm4opt.physics.doeclim`

```text
DOECLIM temperature response: two-box energy balance with a diffusive ocean.

Two-box energy balance (land-air TL, sea-surface TS) coupled to a diffusive
ocean (Kriegler 2005; Tanaka & Kriegler 2007). The Crank-Nicolson system
B*T(n) = Q(n) + A*T(n-1) + DPAST(n) is solved with the precomputed inverse of
B, so each step is an explicit update once the forcing of step n is known.
DPAST2(n) is the ocean-diffusion memory: a convolution of the whole TS history
with the kernel doe_Ker.

Lagged (t-1) terms are 0 at the first step: Q(-1) = TL(-1) = TS(-1) = 0, so
the 1850 forcing acts as a step from zero.

Options (--name=value flags, RunConfig):
  --cm6mdl=<ESM>          parameters from doe_gcm_est_etminan.csv / _myhre.csv
                          (--ch4rfc) or _ssp534.csv (--use_ssp534)
  no --cm6mdl             hard-coded defaults
  --scen=ssp1..ssp5       hard-coded defaults, not the CSV
  --clim_sensi=<ECS>      overrides doe_t2co (ssp1..5 and --cm6mdl branches)
  --scen=tcre / tcre2     fixed parameter set
  --co2_only              DOECLIM forced by rfc_CO2 instead of erf_tot
Derived values are computed from the raw parameters.
```

### class `DoeclimParams`

DOECLIM parameters, named as the doe_* parameters without the prefix.

Fields: `land_sea_hx_slope`, `land_sea_hx_offset`, `heatcap_seawater`, `area_earth`, `diffusivity_unit_conv`, `rf_2xco2`, `land_sens_ratio`, `secs_per_year`, `depth_bottom`, `sst_air_factor`, `heatcap_land`, `heatcap_mixed`, `frac_land`, `frac_ocean_deep`, `climate_sensitivity`, `diffusivity`, `tas_0`, `sst_0`, `nsteps`, `dt`, `area_ocean`, `c_num`, `c_den`, `feedback_land`, `feedback_sea`, `land_sea_hx`, `diffusivity_eff`, `tau_bottom`, `power_to_heat`, `tau_feedback_sea`, `tau_feedback_land`, `tau_diffusion`, `tau_hx_sea`, `tau_hx_land`, `ker_t0`, `ker_ta1`, `ker_tb1`, `ker_ta2`, `ker_tb2`, `ker_ta3`, `ker_tb3`, `ker`, `ker_last`, `mat_c`, `mat_b`, `mat_a`, `temp_d`, `temp`, `mat_b_inv`, `t_lo`, `ref_compat`

### class `DoeclimStep`

One DOECLIM step, named as the doe_* variables.

Fields: `QL`, `QO`, `DelQL`, `DelQO`, `QC1`, `QC2`, `DQ1`, `DQ2`, `DPAST1`, `DPAST2`, `DTEAUX1`, `DTEAUX2`, `temp_landair`, `temp_sst`, `tas`, `heatflux_mixed`, `heatflux_interior`, `heat_mixed`, `heat_interior`, `heatflux`, `heatcontent`

### class `DoeclimDrivers`

Input of one DOECLIM step n.

Fields: `ftot`

### class `DoeclimState`

DOECLIM state after step n-1.

out  : DoeclimStep of that step (the doe_* outputs)
n    : number of steps done
hist : temp_sst history of the run, used by the diffusion integral. The buffer is
       shared by the states of one run: a step from state(n) writes hist[n] and reads
       only hist[:n], so a trial step (computed and discarded) does not disturb the
       run, and the next real step from state(n) overwrites hist[n].

Fields: `out`, `n`, `hist`

### `erf(x)`

erf evaluated as 2*ndtr(x*sqrt(2)) - 1, ndtr = standard normal CDF.

### `load_doeclim_params(cfg=None, nsteps=None)`

DOECLIM parameters of a run configuration; nsteps (the diffusion kernel length)
defaults to the configuration's number of steps.

### `doeclim_step(p, prev, drivers)`

One DOECLIM step: prev = DoeclimState after n-1 (None at the first step),
drivers = DoeclimDrivers; returns the DoeclimState after step n (outputs in .out).
Raises ModelBoundsError if tas or temp_sst leaves [p.t_lo, 50].

### `glue(p, s)`

Temperature links of the full model: scm_D_tatm, scm_tatm, scm_D_sst, scm_sst.

+0 is added where doe_T0 / doe_ST0 were once used (no effect on any value).

### `delsst(sst_m1, sst_m2, n)`

scm_delsst(n) = 2*sst(n-1) - sst(n-2), 0 for n < 2 (not used by other equations).

### `run_doeclim(p, ftot)`

Run DOECLIM offline over a prescribed scm_ftot series.

Returns {doe_* name without the prefix: array} plus the scm_* temperature links.

### `scm_ftot(f, co2_only=False)`

scm_ftot(n), DOECLIM's forcing: erf_tot, or rfc_CO2 with --co2_only.

f : the forcing.ForcingStep of step n.

Constants: `DAT_DIR`, `DEFAULTS`, `DOE_PI`, `DT`, `TCRE`


## `scm4opt.physics.forcing`

```text
Radiative forcing: greenhouse gases, ozone, aerosols, land cover and natural terms.

Every term is evaluated at the same step n from the concentrations of n:
  CO2, CH4, N2O       Etminan (default) or Myhre formulas (--ch4rfc)
  strat. H2O          from the lagged CH4
  halogens, O3, aerosol direct effects   radiative efficiency x anomaly
  aerosol-cloud       log(1 + AERh/AERh_0) + BC semi-direct adjustment
  BC on snow          from BC emissions
  land-cover albedo   regional albedo coefficients x land-cover change
  contrails, volcanic, solar, dust       exogenous (inputs.py)
ERF = RF x efficacy; erf_tot drives DOECLIM.

All forcing model choices are available: the option tables below are keyed by the
option names and are selected with config.ForcingOptions (the forcing model options,
--..._mdl flags). Also included: the --rname list that switches Etminan CO2 forcing to the
simple log form, and rfc_LCC = 0 for the natural-forcing group "zero".

--scen=contrib_rfc (components read from data): forcing_from_data.
Not included: --cali_chem and --cali_rf (efficacies become calibration variables).
```

### class `ForcingParams`

Forcing parameters (model names); build with load_forcing_params().

Fields: `ch4rfc`, `co2_log`, `lcc_zero`, `co2_init`, `co2_0`, `ch4_init`, `ch4_0`, `n2o_init`, `n2o_0`, `rf_2xco2`, `rf_2xco2_etminan`, `scale_rf_co2`, `radeff_halo`, `radeff_o3t`, `radeff_o3s`, `radeff_so4`, `radeff_poa`, `radeff_bc`, `radeff_no3`, `radeff_soa`, `radeff_dust`, `radeff_salt`, `k_bc_adjust`, `cloud_scale`, `aerh_scale`, `rf_ref1`, `aer_ref0`, `aer_ref1`, `phi_0`, `aerh_0`, `warmeff_volc`, `radeff_bc_snow`, `warmeff_bc_snow`, `alpha_lcc`, `alpha_lcc_reg`, `warmeff_lcc`, `p_atm_co2`, `p_atm_no_co2`, `p_atm_o3t`, `p_atm_strat`, `p_atm_scatter`, `p_atm_absorb`, `p_atm_cloud`, `p_atm_alb`, `p_atm_solar`, `efficacy`, `dt`

## `scm4opt.physics.forcing_data`

```text
Forcing tables: halogen radiative efficiencies and land-cover albedo parameters.

Loaded from tables/*.csv in the data folder (config.data_path); edit the CSV
files, not this module, and re-run the regression tests after any edit:

  halo_radeff.csv          gas, radeff_mW_m2_ppt   radeff_HALO(halo) before *1E-3 [mW/m2/ppt]
  lcc_albedo_global.csv    flux, albedo, cover, <land types>
                           alpha_LCC_param(ALBLCflux, ALBLCalb, ALBLCcover, land_type) [W/m2/Mha]
  lcc_albedo_regional.csv  flux, albedo, cover, region, <land types>
                           alpha_LCC_reg_param(..., region_11, land_type) [W/m2/Mha]
Land types in sets.LAND_TYPE order, regions in sets.REGION_11 order. Values are raw table
entries (forcing.py applies the transformations).

The per-experiment forcing options (natural-forcing group, log-form CO2 forcing) are in
rcmip3_data.py (NAT_GRP_BY_RNAME, LOG_CO2_RNAMES), maintained by hand.
```

Constants: `ALPHA_LCC_PARAM`, `ALPHA_LCC_REG_PARAM`, `DAT_DIR`, `LAND_TYPE`, `LOG_CO2_RNAMES`, `NAT_GRP_BY_RNAME`, `RADEFF_HALO`, `REGION_11`

```text
Per-gas parameters of the 48 halogenated gases (lifetimes, molar masses, GWP100).

Loaded from tables/*.csv in the data folder (config.data_path); edit the CSV
files, not this module, and re-run the regression tests after any edit. Values are raw
table entries (chemistry.py applies the transformations: molar mass x 0.1765, tau_hv x
1.06, inf/0 defaults).

halo_parameters.csv -> HALO_TABLE[gas] = tuple in COLUMNS order:
  molar_mass  alpha_HALO before *0.1765
  tau_total   tau_HALO_total_lifetime [yr] (not used by the equations)
  tau_OH      tau_HALO_OH [yr]
  tau_hv_raw  tau_HALO_hv before *1.06 [yr]
  tau_othr    tau_HALO_othr_nzero [yr]; empty (None) -> inf
  n_Cl, n_Br  Cl / Br atoms (ODS only); empty (None) -> 0
  gwp100      def_gwp100_oa2022_ems; empty (None) -> 0
  ("inf" in the file is an infinite lifetime)
halo_fracrel.csv -> FRACREL[option][gas]: f_fracrel(halo_ods) for each --O3Sfracrel_mdl
  option (one column per option); gases absent -> 0
```

Constants: `COLUMNS`, `DAT_DIR`, `FRACREL`, `HALO_TABLE`, `INF`


## `scm4opt.physics.land`

```text
Land carbon cycle: plant, detritus and soil pools with CO2 and temperature feedbacks.

Three pools (plant P, detritus H, soil S) in GtC, MAGICC-style. All fluxes are
GtC per model step. Within step n:

  1. pools(n) from pools(n-1) and the rates of step n-1  (trapezoidal update)
  2. rates(n) from CO2(n), deltem(n) and land-use CO2 emissions(n)
  3. decay(n) = 2 * th(n) * pools(n)
  4. land flux(n) = sum of pool changes; positive = uptake from the atmosphere

Land feels temperature only through deltem(n) = 2*tatm(n-1) - tatm(n-2),
so a step never needs temperature at n.

Options (--name=value flags):
  --cm6mdl=<ESM>          parameters from land_gcm_est.csv, feedbacks x 0.7
  no --cm6mdl             MAGICC6 defaults
                          (cm6mdl=None; the full model always sets a default)
  --scen=tcre / tcre2     derived values recomputed from the raw parameters
  --rname=abrupt-0p5xCO2  sigmoid-only CO2 fertilisation
  --use_ncycle            NPP x nit_npp_scaler(t): LandDrivers.npp_scaler of land_step
Not included: the --cali_lnd calibration branch.
```

### class `LandParams`

Land parameters; parameter names in RAW / DERIVED. Build with load_land_params().

Fields: `npp_0_per_step`, `resp_0_per_step`, `fert_scale`, `beta`, `fert_method`, `k_npp`, `k_resp`, `k_detr`, `k_soil`, `pool_0_p`, `pool_0_h`, `pool_0_s`, `gifford_conc`, `no_regrowth_frac`, `f_npp_to_p`, `f_npp_to_h`, `f_p_to_h`, `f_defo_p`, `f_defo_h`, `f_h_to_s`, `regrow_inter_p`, `regrow_gradi_p`, `regrow_inter_h`, `regrow_gradi_h`, `regrow_inter_s`, `regrow_gradi_s`, `f_npp_to_s`, `f_p_to_s`, `f_defo_s`, `decay_0_p`, `decay_0_h`, `decay_0_s`, `fert_sigmoid_only`, `co2_ref`, `co2_npp_zero`

### class `LandRates`

Everything the land module computes at one step, named as the lnd_* variables.

Fields: `fert_log`, `fert_r`, `fert_b`, `fert_sig`, `fert_fact`, `fg`, `fr`, `fh`, `fs`, `npp`, `nppP`, `nppH`, `nppS`, `resp`, `dpElu`, `dhElu`, `dsElu`, `sumPElu`, `sumHElu`, `sumSElu`, `sumElu`, `tauP`, `tauH`, `tauS`, `regrowP`, `regrowH`, `regrowS`, `grossDP`, `grossDH`, `grossDS`, `grossD`, `thp`, `thh`, `ths`, `dcyP`, `dcyH`, `dcyS`, `rh`, `rhh`, `h2s`, `p2h`, `p2s`, `plnt_pool`, `detr_pool`, `soil_pool`, `terrest_pool`, `atmoLndFlux`

### class `LandDrivers`

Inputs of one land step n.

Fields: `co2`, `deltem`, `elnd_co2`, `npp_scaler`

### `magicc6_land_defaults(dat_dir=DAT_DIR)`

The land parameters of the MAGICC6-defaults mode (MAGICC6 file + SCM4OPT values).

### `load_land_params(cfg=None)`

Land parameters of a run configuration.

### `deltem(tatm_m1, tatm_m2, n, deltT1850=0.0)`

scm_deltem(n): linear extrapolation of tatm from n-1 and n-2; 0 for n < 2.

### `land_step(p, prev, drivers)`

One step of the land carbon cycle.

p          : LandParams
prev       : LandRates of step n-1, or None at the first step (1850)
drivers    : LandDrivers of step n:
co2        : scm_atmoCO2(n) [ppm]
dtem       : scm_deltem(n) [K]
elnd_co2   : dat_elnd(n,"co2") [GtC/step]
npp_scaler : nit_npp_scaler(n) from the N cycle (--use_ncycle), or None
Returns the LandRates of step n; its atmoLndFlux feeds the atmosphere at n+1.

### `run_land(p, co2, tatm, elnd_co2, npp_scaler=None)`

Run the land module offline over prescribed series (all length N).

co2 : scm_atmoCO2 [ppm]; tatm : scm_tatm [K]; elnd_co2 : dat_elnd(t,"co2");
npp_scaler : nit_npp_scaler series (--use_ncycle) or None.
Returns {variable name without the lnd_ prefix: array}, plus "deltem".

Constants: `CO2_CONC_1850`, `CO2_NPP_ZERO_CONC`, `DAT_DIR`, `DERIVED`, `DT`, `MAGICC6_LAND_CSV`, `OUTPUTS`, `RAW`, `SCM4OPT_LAND_DEFAULTS`


## `scm4opt.physics.ocean_hector`

```text
Hector v1.0 ocean carbon module.

Hartin, C. A., P. Patel, A. Schwarber, R. P. Link and B. P. Bond-Lamberty (2015),
"A simple object-oriented and open-source model for scientific and policy analyses of
the global climate system - Hector v1.0", Geosci. Model Dev. 8, 939-955.

Four boxes: surface low latitude (ob_LL), surface high latitude (ob_HL), intermediate
(ob_IO) and deep (ob_DO). The two surface boxes have carbonate chemistry (DIC + fixed
alkalinity -> [H+], pCO2, pH, Omega, Revelle) and exchange CO2 with the atmosphere
(Takahashi et al. 2009); carbon moves between boxes by advection (thermohaline and
high-latitude overturning) and two-way exchange.

It is an alternative to the default OSCAR ocean, selected with --ocean_model=hector, and
can also be run standalone. Its equations are explicit in time like the rest of SCM4OPT,
so one step is (step n):

  carbon(n)   = carbon(n-1) + carbon_flux(n-1)          (carbon_initial at n = 0)
  Tbox(n)     = scm_tatm(n) * warmingfactor + 15 + deltaT
  chemistry   LL/HL: DIC from carbon(n); [H+] from the alkalinity equation (the only
              implicit relation: solved by brentq inside the bounds of hct_H)
  atmos_flux  (scm_atmoCO2(n) - pCO2o * cpoolscale) * Tr * As * 12 / 1e15 * scm_dt
  carbon_flux(n) = transport/exchange in - out + atmos_flux(n)

Options (load_hector_params):
  cm6mdl       --cm6mdl: transports, initial carbon, cpoolscale, warming factors, U and S
               from data/CMIP6/ocean_gcm_est.csv; None: Hector defaults
  scen         --scen=tcre|tcre2: transports and initial carbon overridden. Reference
               behaviour (ref_compat, default): the tcre transport overrides do not change
               the k-rates; --ref_compat=0 or --hector_tcre_rates recomputes them
  same_alk     --same_alk: all boxes use the mean of the LL/HL alkalinities
Calibration hooks (--cali / --gene) are not included. The Hector reference output
(data/hector/ocean26.csv, rcp_out and the *_hct parameters, used only for comparison) is
available through load_hector_reference.

Usage (offline, prescribed temperature and CO2):
  from scm4opt.physics.ocean_hector import load_hector_params, run_hector
  p = load_hector_params(RunConfig())           # or RunConfig(cm6mdl="ACCESS-CM2",
                                                #   ocean=OceanOptions(same_alk=True))
  out = run_hector(p, tatm, co2)                # arrays over steps -> dict of arrays
Coupled: hector_step(p, prev, OceanDrivers(co2=..., tatm=...)), via ocean_models.
Coupled: python3 -m scm4opt --ocean_model=hector [--same_alk=1] replaces the
OSCAR ocean by this module in scm4opt.py: step n uses scm_tatm(n) and
scm_atmoCO2(n), and s.atmoSeaFlux (GtC per step, positive into the ocean) enters the
atmosphere at n+1 like ocn_atmoSeaFlux. scm_ocn_surface_cpool / scm_ocn_total_cpool are
the LL+HL and the four-box carbon.
```

### class `HectorParams`

Hector ocean parameters; arrays over BOXES.

Fields: `circ_thermohaline`, `circ_hl_overturning`, `exch_warm_inter`, `exch_inter_deep`, `exch_cold_deep`, `exch_warm_cold`, `exch_cold_inter`, `dt`, `secs_per_step`, `thick_ll`, `thick_hl`, `thick_inter`, `thick_deep`, `area`, `part_high`, `part_low`, `volume_ll`, `volume_hl`, `volume_io`, `volume_do`, `transport_k`, `exchange_k`, `delta_t`, `salinity`, `volume`, `area_surface`, `wind_speed`, `alk`, `carbon_initial`, `cpool_scale`, `warming_factor`, `check_bounds`

### class `HectorChem`

Chemistry of one surface box (outputs hct_<field>, over CHEM_BOXES).

Fields: `dic`, `tc`, `tk`, `lnK0`, `K0`, `Sc`, `lnKw`, `Kw`, `nKhwe74`, `Kh`, `pK1mehr`, `K1`, `pK2mehr`, `K2`, `lnKb`, `Kb`, `log10Kspc`, `Kspc`, `log10Kspa`, `Kspa`, `bor`, `H`, `co2st`, `hco3`, `co3`, `PCO2o`, `pH`, `Tr`, `calcium`, `OmegaCa`, `OmegaAr`, `Revelle`

### class `HectorStep`

State of step n (outputs hct_<field>).

Fields: `Tbox`, `carbon`, `chem`, `atmos_flux`, `atmoSeaFlux`, `transport`, `exchange`, `carbon_flux`, `total_carbon`

### `load_hector_params(cfg=None)`

Hector ocean parameters of a run configuration (--cm6mdl, --scen, --same_alk,
--hector_tcre_rates).

### `convert_to_dic(carbon, volume)`

DIC of a box from its carbon: PgC -> umol/kg (times OCN_SCALE).

### `constants(tc, S)`

Equilibrium constants of a box at temperature tc [degC], salinity S.

### `alk_residual(H, dic, alk, k)`

Alkalinity balance, LHS - RHS, for [H+] (scaled by OCN_SCALE).

### `surface_chemistry(carbon, Tbox, S, U, volume, alk, H_bounds=(0.001, 0.1))`

Carbonate chemistry of one surface box from its carbon [PgC] and temperature.

### `calc_monthly_surface_flux(Ca, PCO2o, cpscale, Tr)`

calc_monthly_surface_flux macro: gC m-2 month-1.

### `calc_annual_surface_flux(Ca, PCO2o, cpscale, Tr, As)`

calc_annual_surface_flux macro: PgC/yr.

### `hector_step(p, prev, drivers)`

One step: prev = HectorStep of n-1 (None at the first step); drivers =
OceanDrivers, uses tatm = scm_tatm(n) [K anomaly] and co2 = scm_atmoCO2(n) [ppm].

### `run_hector(p, tatm, co2, check_bounds=True)`

Offline run over prescribed scm_tatm and scm_atmoCO2; returns {model name: array}.

### `collect_hector(steps)`

HectorStep list -> {model name: array}; chemistry arrays are (n, 2) over CHEM_BOXES.
Output names carry the Hector prefix hct_. Also hct_surface_cpool (LL + HL carbon) and
hct_total_cpool (all boxes), which the coupled run reports as scm_ocn_surface_cpool /
scm_ocn_total_cpool.

### `load_hector_reference(dat_dir=None, name='ocean26.csv')`

Hector v1.0 reference output rcp_out (data/hector/ocean26.csv):
the raw table (index = t label) plus hct_<name>_ref arrays (Hector's own output for
the hct_<name> variables), and the
drivers simpleNbox_Ca (CO2, ppm) and temperature_Tgav (K).

Constants: `ALK_HL`, `ALK_LL`, `BOUNDS`, `BOXES`, `CHEM_BOXES`, `DAT_DIR`, `DO`, `DT`, `HCT_COLUMNS`, `HECTOR_CSV_COLS`, `HL`, `IO`, `LL`, `MEAN_GLOBAL_TEMP`, `OCN_MILLION`, `OCN_SCALE`, `OCN_THOUSAND`, `TCRE`, `TCRE_CARBON`


## `scm4opt.physics.ocean_models`

```text
Ocean carbon models as plug-ins, selected with --ocean_model.

Every ocean model provides
  load_params(cfg)              -> parameters
  step(params, prev, drivers)   -> state of step n; prev = state of n-1 or None
  collect(states)               -> {output name: array over t}
and its states expose atmoSeaFlux (GtC per step into the ocean), surface_cpool and
total_cpool (GtC), which couple it to the rest of the model. All take the same
OceanDrivers; each uses the fields it needs.
```

### class `OceanDrivers`

Inputs of one ocean step n (fields an ocean model does not use may be None).

Fields: `co2`, `d_co2`, `tatm`, `d_sst`

### class `OceanModel`

Fields: `name`, `prefix`, `load_params`, `step`, `collect`

### `get_ocean_model(name)`

The OceanModel registered under --ocean_model=name.

Constants: `OCEAN_MODELS`


## `scm4opt.physics.ocean_oscar`

```text
Ocean carbon: OSCAR-type ocean carbon cycle (mixed-layer boxes).

The surface ocean is split into 8 boxes (fractions p_circ and timescales
tau_circ of the chosen box model) that exchange CO2 with the atmosphere and
export carbon to the deep ocean. Each model step is integrated with `nsub`
explicit Euler sub-steps (--ocn_nsub, default 4). Carbon is in GtC, fluxes in
GtC/step.

Order within step n (needs scm_D_sst(n), so the ocean runs AFTER DOECLIM):
  sub-step s=1   starts from the end state of n-1 and uses its outflows
  sub-step s>1   uses the outflows evaluated at sub-step s-1
  sea flux(n)    = -sum_s sum_b (FOUT_sub(n,b,s) - FIN(n-1,b)) * dt_sub
  FIN(n)         = from scm_D_CO2(n); used by the sub-steps of n+1

Reference behaviour (ref_compat, default; README: Reference compatibility): the sea flux sums FOUT over
sub-steps 1..nsub of n, while the box integration uses FOUT from the end of n-1 and
sub-steps 1..nsub-1, so ocean and atmosphere carbon are not exactly mass-consistent
(identical to the SCM4OPT v4.1 reference results). With --ref_compat=0 the sea flux
uses the outflows that drive the integration: flux = change of the surface boxes +
export to the deep ocean.

Options (config.OceanOptions, RunConfig.cm6mdl / rname):
  --cm6mdl=<ESM>           alpha_mld..sst_0 from ocean_gcm_osc_est.csv
  no --cm6mdl              surf_layer(v_osn_model) + tbl_OSNKtrans(mod_OSNKtrans)
  v_osn_model              box model: HILDA | BD-model | 2D-model | 3D-model
  mod_OSNKchem, --pco2_form, pco2_w_*   pCO2 emulator: Poly | Pade | Power, weighted
  --ocn_nsub               number of sub-steps
  --rname=abrupt-0p5xCO2   sst_0 = max(17.1, sst_0)
Derived values keep their reference formulas.
```

### class `OceanParams`

Ocean parameters, named as in the model; build with load_ocean_params().

Fields: `alpha_mld`, `gamma_mld`, `gas_exchange_rate`, `area_ocean`, `mld_0`, `sst_0`, `p_circ`, `tau_circ`, `w_poly`, `w_pade`, `w_power`, `n_substeps`, `alpha_co2`, `alpha_sol`, `co2_0`, `f_temp`, `dt`, `flux_bounds`, `ref_compat`

### class `OceanStep`

One step of the ocean module, named as the ocn_D_* / ocn_* variables.

Fields: `D_mld`, `D_FIN`, `D_FOUT`, `D_FCIRC`, `D_CSURF`, `D_CSURF_all`, `D_dic`, `D_pCO2`, `D_dic_sub`, `D_pCO2_sub`, `D_FOUT_sub`, `D_FCIRC_sub`, `D_CSURF_sub`, `atmoSeaFlux`, `surface_cpool`, `total_cpool`

### `pco2_switch(o)`

ocn_pCO2_switch(Poly, Pade, Power), normalised.

### `load_ocean_params(cfg=None)`

OSCAR ocean parameters of a run configuration.

### `f_dic(p, D_CSURF, D_mld)`

DIC anomaly [umol/kg] from surface carbon [GtC] (f_dic macro).

### `dic_attribution(p, D_CSURF, D_mld)`

dic_df_1 (carbon), dic_df_2 (mixed-layer depth), dic_df_tot, df_dic1, df_dic2.

### `f_pCO2_pade(p, D_dic, D_sst)`

CO2Sys Pade approximant (f_pCO2_pade macro), pCO2 anomaly [ppm].

### `f_pCO2_power(p, D_dic, D_sst)`

CO2Sys power law (f_pCO2_power macro), pCO2 anomaly [ppm].

### `f_pCO2_poly(p, D_dic, D_sst)`

Joos (2001) polynomial used in OSCARv3 (f_pCO2_poly macro), pCO2 anomaly [ppm].

### `pco2_anomaly(p, D_dic, D_sst)`

Weighted pCO2 emulator, as in ocn_D_pCO2_sub_EQ (zero-weight forms are skipped).

### `ocean_step(p, prev, drivers)`

One step of the ocean carbon module.

prev    : OceanStep of step n-1, or None at the first step (1850)
drivers : OceanDrivers; uses d_co2 = scm_D_CO2(n) [ppm] and d_sst = scm_D_sst(n) [K]
          (DOECLIM at the same step). p.flux_bounds: check the scm_atmoSeaFlux bounds.
Returns the OceanStep of step n; its atmoSeaFlux feeds the atmosphere at n+1.

### `collect_ocean(steps)`

OceanStep list -> {ocn_<field>: array over t} (per-box (N, 8), sub-steps (N, ..., nsub)).

### `run_ocean(p, d_co2, d_sst)`

Run the ocean offline over prescribed scm_D_CO2 and scm_D_sst series.

Returns {variable name without the ocn_ prefix: array}; per-box variables have
shape (N, 8) and sub-step ones (N, nsub) or (N, 8, nsub).

Constants: `ALPHA_CO2`, `ALPHA_SOL`, `CO2_0`, `DAT_DIR`, `DT`, `FT`, `INF`, `OBOX`, `PREIND_INTERDEEP_C`, `PREIND_SURFACE_C`, `P_CIRC_TBL`, `SURF_LAYER`, `TAU_CIRC_TBL`, `TBL_OSNKTRANS`
